verses.text: Also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial, and bodies telestial; but the glory of the celestial, one; and the terrestrial, another; and the telestial, another.

title: JST, 1 Corinthians 15:40. Compare 1 Corinthians 15:40 There are three degrees of glory in the Resurrection.
